notes:
Overview:
- Enterprise evaluation focused on Redwood Dedicated for mission-critical inference workloads (clinical decision support + patient-facing chat).
- Primary ask: SLA that supports regulatory/clinical uptime expectations and clear credit schedule.

Timeline / activities (recent):
- 2025-11-03: Intro call (Maya) — high level requirements, showed Dedicated ROI calc.
- 2025-12-15: Capacity planning workshop (SE Diego present) — agreed initial commit of 8 GPUs (A10/A100 equiv), target baseline throughput 18-22 qps for short-chat flows.
- 2026-01-20: SLA deep-dive (recorded: ff_2026-01-20_helixcare_sla_review) — legal + security joined. Raised uptime bar to 99.99% for production endpoints.
- 2026-02-10: On-prem deployment feasibility call and pilot sequencing (ff_2026-02-10_dedicated_capacity_demo).
- 2026-02-18: Pricing & SLA revision 2 received from Redwood (redline shared in drive).

SLA / contract specifics requested by HelixCare (summary of asks):
- Uptime target: 99.99% for prod endpoints; want calendar-year measurement with monthly reporting.
- Credit schedule: prefer graduated credits: 10% monthly service credit for monthly uptime 99.90%–99.99%, 30% credit for 99.0%–99.90%, and termination rights if <99.0% for two consecutive months. Pushback: Redwood proposed 5% / 15% bands.
- Maintenance windows: HelixCare requires planned maintenance to be scheduled in a 2-hour window between 02:00–05:00 local (customer-hosted region); emergency maintenance requires 12‑hour notice and joint rollback plan.
- Support SLAs: P1 initial response < 15 minutes (phone + Slack), P1 mitigation plan within 4 hours, P2 response within 1 business hour, followed by 24‑72h resolution targets. HelixCare requests a named escalation path and monthly incident review.
- Throughput & Latency SLOs: p95 latency for 128-token chat generation < 200ms on committed capacity; sustained throughput target = 400k tokens/min across the pool. Redwood suggested burst to hosted for overcommit.
- Capacity guarantees: committed pool = 8 GPUs reserved, with contractual burst add-on of up to +4 GPUs within 30 minutes notice for traffic spikes; autoscaling policy and on-call capacity windows to be defined.
- Data residency & security: all inference logs stored in-region; KMS envelope encryption required for model keys; audit logs retained 7 years for compliance team.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Estimated ARR range $300k-$750k depending on final commit length (12 vs 36 months) and burst pricing.
- Procurement wants firm penalty schedule for SLA misses; Redwood legal pushing back on termination thresholds.
- Pricing deck v2 in drive; finance asks for monthly invoicing option (vs quarterly).

Open technical questions / engineering follow-ups:
- Exact p95 latency baseline needs a 24h production-like run (Diego to schedule with bench infra).
- KMS integration cadence — HelixCare requires HSM/KMS timeline before GA; SEC ticket SEC-2201 tracking.
- On‑prem install window: need a detailed runbook and 1-week blackout period for integration testing.

Quotes / callouts from HelixCare stakeholders:
- "We need measurable penalties — our internal SLA to clinicians is non-negotiable." — Head of IT Ops.
- "If latency slips, clinical adoption stalls — can't accept fuzzy SLOs." — VP Product.

Next steps (short):
- Maya to coordinate legal-to-legal redline call w/ Redwood legal and HelixCare procurement (target week of 2026-03-02).
- Diego to run 24h perf baseline on committed 8‑GPU config (target 2026-02-25).
- Priya (CSM) to provision monthly incident review cadence and prepare runbook template.
- Draft final SLA appendix v0.3 to include explicit credit schedule (Maya / Redwood Legal).

Blockers: 
- Procurement hold until credit schedule and termination rights clarified.
- Security wants KMS proof-of-concept completed before signing.

Staging notes / internal guidance for AE/SE: 
- Redwood negotiating position: accept 99.99% uptime where feasible but push narrower credit bands (5%/20%) and longer cure periods; offer dedicated 4-hour emergency rollback assistance; propose 30-day notice for planned maintenance with option to lock windows.
- Consider including an SLA escalation add-on with named SREs and 24x7 pager for an additional fee to satisfy HelixCare risk appetite.
- Financial concession: deeper discount for 36-month commit and prepayment.

CRM shorthand (recent activity log):
- 02/18: Received legal redline. AE requested internal pricing approval.
- 02/12: Follow-up w/ security on KMS timeline.
- 02/01: Demo of burst routing + fallback to hosted.
- 01/20: SLA workshop w/ legal.
